THE COLUMNS ARE NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, WHICH WAS READ AND WRITTEN DOWN, and the same header is printed on all three pages: BEGINNING PRINCIPAL | BEGINNING EARNINGS | CONTRIBUTE TO PRINCIPAL | NET EARNINGS | DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL | TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS | ENDING CASH VALUE | UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS | ENDING MARKET VALUE. This is the nine-column layout FY2014 established, and FY2015 ACCEPTS it: every column is present and in the same order. DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL and TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS are printed in parentheses, in red, where they are not nil, and are stored NEGATIVE as printed. A CELL THE PAGE LEAVES BLANK IS ABSENT, NOT ZERO, and is not written -- which matters only on the other-banks block, where most columns are blank. WHAT PROVES IT -- THREE LAYERS, ALL OF THEM THE PAGE'S OWN ARITHMETIC. (1) EVERY FUND ROW closes twice: its six components sum to its ENDING CASH VALUE, and that plus UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS is its ENDING MARKET VALUE. (2) EVERY SECTION closes to the SUBTOTALS row the page prints beneath it, in all nine columns. (3) THE WHOLE STATEMENT closes to the GRAND TOTALS row on page 40, in all nine columns, from the six section subtotals plus the six other-bank funds. PAGE 40 IS A HOLE IN THE PAGE MAP: it prints ONE row -- GRAND TOTALS -- and five money figures, so recognition never saw fifteen on it and it was listed nowhere, while pages 38 and 39 were. It is the row the other two pages cannot be proved without, which is the third year running that the missing page has carried the totals (FY2018 p50, FY2022 p46 and p48). AND PAGE 39's OWN `GRAND TOTALS` ROW IS NOT THE STATEMENT'S GRAND TOTAL. It foots the six sections only -- $2,080,085.36 of beginning principal, $2,362,691.30 of ending market value -- and the TRUST FUNDS HELD BY OTHER BANKS block is printed BELOW it, with no subtotal of its own. Page 40's GRAND TOTALS is page 39's plus that block, exactly, in every one of the nine columns: beginning principal $2,080,085.36 + $256,402.47 = $2,336,487.83, and ending market value $2,362,691.30 + $255,851.67 = $2,618,542.97. A reader who takes page 39's row as the town's trust holdings is short by $255,851.67, and $227,542.95 of that is the Zoning Incentive Stabilization account at TD Banknorth.
